source_clause: C19) Tri-Mode Climate: On vehicles with Tri-Mode climate, there are 3 airflow mode buttons (Windshield, Face, Feet) on the Tri-Mode Climate screen. Each Mode button can be pressed to individually toggle ON / OFF which provides 7 possible distribution modes. Pressing the hard control MODE button will cycle through all MODE combinations (repeating the process so it loops at the end of each cycle). The airflow mode combinations will cycle in this order: (Face, Face & Feet, Feet, Windshield & Feet, Windshield, Windshield & Face, Windshield & Face & Feet). If the MODE button is a multi-directional toggle or a hard control that allows 2 controls (UP/DOWN or RIGHT/LEFT) then the user can navigate through the cycle of modes. Toggling UP (or RIGHT) moves forward in the order and toggling DOWN (or LEFT) moves backwards through the cycle.
reasoning: 驗證目標：3.1（C19）定義 Tri-Mode 之三個 airflow mode 按鈕與 MODE 硬鍵之循環，三個 037 leaf 分別對應「個別 toggle」「單向循環順序」「多向前後移動」，三者之操作元件與失效形態互異，故一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）。關鍵情境條件：配置軸取 profile §3.2 第三軸「tri-mode 有無」，其 R-C28 第一問由條文首句「On vehicles with Tri-Mode climate」明文對應，標 spec-verbatim；硬鍵之存在由「Pressing the hard control MODE button」一句推得，標 spec-derived。為什麼這樣切：三條之失效可各自獨立發生（個別 toggle 正常而循環順序錯，或循環正常而反向移動錯），合併後無法定位。**EMEA ICS 排除式 PC 已依 37 §1 移除** —— `ch16_mirror_map.tsv` 判 3.1 為 no-counterpart（16.12 ICE11 為 5 states 單選，非 tri-mode 之三鍵組合），原排除建立在「ch2／ch3 於 ch16 有對應」此一對本節為假之前提上。刻意略過：條文列出七種組合而未定義開機預設模式，故循環之起點由 procedure 第一步建立而非寫入 pre_conditions（§7 FF ＋ R-C28 第三問）；「7 possible distribution modes」之計數本身不另立 TC，它是 -02 循環之結果而非獨立行為。

tcs.tc_title: Each Tri-Mode airflow button toggles independently
tcs.test_item: On vehicles with Tri-Mode climate, each of the three airflow mode buttons (Windshield, Face, Feet) on the Tri-Mode Climate screen shall be pressable to individually toggle that mode ON / OFF
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-verbatim] The vehicle is equipped with Tri-Mode climate (3.1)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Tri-Mode Climate screen
2. Press the "Face" mode button
3. Press the "Face" mode button again
4. Press the "Feet" mode button
5. Press the "Windshield" mode button
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Tri-Mode Climate screen shows the "Windshield", "Face" and "Feet" mode buttons
2. The Face mode is toggled ON and the Windshield and Feet modes are unchanged
3. The Face mode is toggled OFF and the Windshield and Feet modes are unchanged
4. The Feet mode is toggled ON and the Windshield and Face modes are unchanged
5. The Windshield mode is toggled ON and the Face and Feet modes are unchanged
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: MODE hard control cycles the airflow combinations in order
tcs.test_item: On vehicles with Tri-Mode climate, pressing the hard control MODE button shall cycle through all MODE combinations in the order Face, Face & Feet, Feet, Windshield & Feet, Windshield, Windshield & Face, Windshield & Face & Feet, and shall loop at the end of each cycle
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-verbatim] The vehicle is equipped with Tri-Mode climate (3.1)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle has a hard control MODE button (3.1)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the hard control MODE button repeatedly until the Face mode alone is active
2. Press the hard control MODE button
3. Press the hard control MODE button
4. Press the hard control MODE button
5. Press the hard control MODE button
6. Press the hard control MODE button
7. Press the hard control MODE button
8. Press the hard control MODE button
tcs.expected_result:
1. Only the Face mode is active
2. The Face and Feet modes are active
3. Only the Feet mode is active
4. The Windshield and Feet modes are active
5. Only the Windshield mode is active
6. The Windshield and Face modes are active
7. The Windshield, Face and Feet modes are active
8. Only the Face mode is active

tcs.tc_title: Multi-directional MODE control moves forward and backward
tcs.test_item: If the MODE button is a multi-directional toggle or a hard control that allows 2 controls (UP/DOWN or RIGHT/LEFT), toggling UP (or RIGHT) shall move forward in the order of airflow mode combinations and toggling DOWN (or LEFT) shall move backwards through the cycle
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-verbatim] The vehicle is equipped with Tri-Mode climate (3.1)
2. [spec-verbatim] The MODE button is a multi-directional toggle or a hard control that allows 2 controls (UP/DOWN or RIGHT/LEFT) (3.1)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Toggle the MODE control repeatedly until the Face mode alone is active
2. Toggle the MODE control UP (or RIGHT)
3. Toggle the MODE control UP (or RIGHT)
4. Toggle the MODE control DOWN (or LEFT)
5. Toggle the MODE control DOWN (or LEFT)
tcs.expected_result:
1. Only the Face mode is active
2. The Face and Feet modes are active
3. Only the Feet mode is active
4. The Face and Feet modes are active
5. Only the Face mode is active
